message:
Let me check which fuzzer is actually used as the target. Let me look at the build setup and how the target is compiled:

<｜｜DSML｜｜=execute_bash>
<parameter=command>find /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul -name "build.sh" -o -name "*.sh" | xargs grep -l "fuzz\|jq" 2>/dev/null | head && echo "---" && ls /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/jq/build/ 2>/dev/null</parameter>
</｜｜DSML｜｜>
